row.notes: Collects unique 32-bit entrant-style ids (type byte plus u16, ordered by type<<14|id) from the championship structure reached via +0x48 or (+0x40)->+0x88->+0x260->+0x2b0 (per-entry lists of 0x88 records at +0x5c and an id array at +0x80), inserts each as a key into the red-black map at +0x30 (node 0x48 bytes, size +0x38) with an empty vector value, then walks the object list at (+0x50)->+0x310 and appends each object to the vector of the key found at (obj+200)+0x3c/+0x3e. Groups items by team for team select and HQ screens.
